html:
The Battle of Manila was fought from February to March 1945, when American and Filipino forces retook the Philippine capital from Japan at the end of the Pacific War.

Japanese troops held out street by street, and massacred civilians in the city. American artillery leveled much of the old city. About 100,000 civilians died, and the walled Intramuros was reduced to rubble.

Manila was among the most destroyed Allied cities of World War II. Japan's occupation since 1942, with the Bataan Death March and the guerrilla war, had already cost many lives. Independence came on 4 July 1946 in a ruined capital. See Douglas MacArthur.
sum: The Battle of Manila was fought from February to March 1945, when American and Filipino forces retook the Philippine capital from Japan at the end of the Pacific War.
